EXTRACT OF THE END-OF-COMMISSION REPORT OF THE OCEANOGRAPHIC STATION
ISLAND OF TRINIDAD - PERIOD FROM NOVEMBER 1, 1957 TO JANUARY 16, 1958
OF CC CARLOS ALBERTO FERREIRA BACELLAR

On December 31st, a radio cipher was sent to EMA, with information to DHN,
stating that an unidentified flying object, in the form of
well-flattened revolution ellipsoid, stainless steel color, at an altitude of about 1600 meters,
moving at a vertiginous speed in an approximate northeasterly direction, making no noise. The object was seen by the doctor, 1st Lt. Ignácio Carlos Moreira Murta, 1st CI-SI Sebastião

Soriano de Souza and five other workers from Cia. Moraes Rego, one of whom—the first to
spot the object—stated that he had seen it previously, on December 5, and that he had reported

this to his colleagues, it not having been taken seriously. Both times it was almost eight
in the morning.

The following day, January 1st, all attention was focused on the sky when something appeared, seen by about twenty men of the garrison, and which was said to be the same object; I was also alert and it seemed to me, however, to be a gull. The object - or gull - was projected across the sky and thus there was no sense of depth; moving in the northeast direction, at a certain point in its trajectory it shone intensely, though perhaps for less than a second. If it was a gull, its speed would be great, but within the reasonable; if it was...
really the object, should be at a considerable distance and in this case, its speed was

incredible. This fact was not communicated to EMA due to the doubt that persisted.
Finally, on the 16th, around 1100, I was already on board the NE "Almirante Saldanha",
after the change of command at the post, when I was notified that an unidentified aerial object
had been seen from the ship, over the island. I was in my cabin at that moment, and immediately
went up to the deck, where I found several people a little excited about what had been seen.
they had seen, among these Mr. Almiro Baraúna, a professional photographer, who had accompanied various
scuba divers heading to Trindade Island to take underwater photographs. Mr. Baraúna was particularly excited having taken several plates of the object and being in great anticipation,

doubted that he had achieved a positive result. I did not distance myself from that person in order to
verify the authenticity of the negatives. I saw him, still on the loading dock, remove the film roll from
the camera and followed to the darkroom to watch the development, not having entered due to the strong
heat that was making, staying outside during the time needed for the operation, that is, 10 minutes.
Leaving the darkroom, still with the film in the tank, I saw him remove it and witnessed his disappointment
when, quite nervous, he supposed he had not succeeded. I took the film, examined it more closely and, in
three negatives and in different positions, I noticed the presence of a strange spot that later:
it was perfectly identified. The film remained in Mr. Baraúna's possession, who, upon my insistence,

he committed to attending the EMA if necessary. Upon arriving in Rio, I went there and handled the case with CC José Geraldo Brandão, giving a verbal statement. From then on, everything that was done was the exclusive initiative of the EMA.

Brasilia, 2 of JoLhO of 2011.
JOSE ROBERTO BUENO

More than fifteen years having passed since the supposedly occurred event, it becomes impossible
to clarify the reason for the deployment of those vehicles in the mentioned region.

In the general protocol of the Office, no request on the subject was found in the year 2008. Only on January 21, 2010, was the first request made for O

The Army Command has made a statement regarding the Request of the Brazilian UFO Commission,
having responded to this Ministry through ofício no 0170-A/3.2 on March 11, 2010.

h) What was the reason for the supposed fear of the EsSA Command, or the Army Intelligence, that prevented the clarification and disclosure among ufologists and the press in general, of the internal inquiries adopted by that School between May 1996 and June 1997, and of its conclusions that the "Varginha ET" was no more than "Sr. Mudinho"?

At no point did the Force omit or fail to clarify facts that were in the public domain. Allegations to the contrary are mere speculations.
i) What reasons led to the "polite, friendly, and just" request for silence about IPM made by military from ESSA to researcher and lawyer of Vitório Pacaccini, Ubirajara Franco Rodrigues?

The internet by Ubirajara Franco Rodrigues is a recent comment and as such, has not been a target
from the inquiries conducted through the administrative procedures established at the time.

had been punished for committing some illicit act, for what reason the very commander of that

The school would initiate a new investigation procedure, this time regarding the IPM, eight months later, with the purpose of determining if the authors of the book “Incidents in Varginha - Space Creatures in Southern Minas”, Vitório Pacaccini and Max Portes, committed new illicit acts, if everything recorded in the book had already been reported by the press, ufologists, and investigated by the equally secretive previous inquiry of the ESSA?
The IPM, established on January 29, 1997, aimed to investigate the content
from the work titled “Varginha Incident - Space Creatures in Southern Minas”.
k) Apart from the discussed diligences that resulted in the inquiry and IPM, the Force

Terrestrial conducted any other internal procedure or in conjunction with another governmental institution, such as the Fire Department or the Military Police of Minas Gerais, using its logistics during those initial months of 1996 in the city of Varginha and its surroundings, resulting in the capture of strange creatures and/or the rescue of an unidentified object, forwarding these things to other institutions like the Humanists Hospital and the University of Campinas, storing them in military areas or transporting/donating the material to other agencies, as cited by other civilian witnesses in Pacaccine and Portes' work, but that...
No military installation or military equipment was used for

storing or transporting any type of cargo, as referred to in the Information Request No. 679, 2011. The genuine information and investigations about the aforementioned events in the region of: Varginha - MG and Três Corações - MG are contained in the administrative procedures established and duly forwarded to the 4th Military Judicial Circuit, an organ of the Judiciary, who was responsible for deciding on the matter.
